title: Cooldown: phone temperature monitor for Android
description: Cooldown shows your phone's battery temperature, alerts you when it overheats, and tells you what is heating it up. Free on Google Play, along with Angora, Pipit, Somna and Wattlab.
og_title: Cooldown: know why your phone gets hot
og_description: Battery temperature, overheating alerts and practical ways to cool your phone down. Free on Google Play.
ld_description: Phone temperature and battery temperature monitor with overheating alerts and cooling tips.
h1: Know why your phone gets hot.
lede: Cooldown shows your battery temperature, alerts you when your phone overheats, and tells you what is heating it up. Low-temperature mode can also dim the screen for you.
free_note: Free. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
hero_alt: Cooldown overview: the battery is at {t_hero}, status Normal, with Low-temperature mode and heat alerts turned on
heat_body: Phones warm up when they charge, stream or run games, and some warmth is normal. Cooldown puts every battery reading on one scale, and alerts you when it reaches your alert threshold, {threshold} by default.
scale_caption: A battery temperature scale from 30 to 50°C, divided into Cooldown's four levels: Normal, Warm, Overheated and Critical. A reading of {t_alert} falls in Overheated.
notice_text: Battery {t_alert} · Pause gaming, camera, navigation, or hotspot use.
screens_title: Check it at a glance, or look back later.

shot.widget_alt: Home screen with Cooldown widgets reading {w1}, {w2} and {t_alert}
shot.widget_body: The widget shows the latest reading, so you can check it without opening the app.
shot.insights_alt: Temperature insights for the last 24 hours: minimum {min}, maximum {max}, average {avg}
shot.insights_body: Minimum, maximum and average temperature, and how long your phone stayed above your alert threshold.
shot.events_alt: Heating events with how much the temperature rose, and charging sessions with their peak temperature
shot.events_body: When your phone heated up, how fast it rose, and how hot each charge got.

screens_note: Insights are part of Pro, or watch an optional ad to unlock them for 24 hours. Screens show example data.
reviews_sub: Five-star reviews from Google Play, quoted as written.
nots: It doesn't claim to cool your phone instantly.
It doesn't force-stop apps or lock CPU and GPU speeds.
It doesn't need root or read private system files.
honest_body: Cooldown shows what is really heating your phone, and how to cool it down safely. Readings come from Android itself, so the available sensors vary by device.
pro_body: Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It removes ads and adds temperature insights, detailed heat-risk signals, a custom alert threshold, color themes and transparent widgets.

angora.what: Find duplicate and large files, see what fills your storage, and free up space safely, with nothing deleted until you confirm.

pipit.what: Resize photos and signatures to the exact file size a form asks for, like 20 KB, 50 KB or 100 KB.

somna.what: A sleep diary with a 6-week program based on cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia.

wattlab.what: See the real watts going into your battery, find out why a charge is slow, and rank your chargers and cables.
